# Objection Handling

`objection-handling` · v1.1.0 · Design · Sales & Pipeline
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/objection-handling/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Is this competitor battlecard honest, sourced and complete enough for reps to use in live deals?

**Inputs:** The real objections, the differentiator and proof, and the main competitors.

**Output:** An objection-handling framework and competitor battlecards, plus disqualify signals.

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill objection-handling`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/objection-handling/resources/battlecard.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/objection-handling/resources/battlecard.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It checks that competitor facts have a source and a date and that our wins have proof, not that either is true. Someone must open each source.
- Facts unchecked for more than 90 days are flagged; that window is the engine's rule. A rival that changed pricing last week is not caught.
- The disparagement and absolutes scan is a word list. The same claim in other words passes.
- The objection type you enter is trusted, not checked. The won/lost record carries a 90% interval; with few deals the range is wide and is not a trend.

**Review before acting:** The sales lead or product marketer re-opens each competitor source and confirms every proof point is real and cleared to share before the card goes to reps. Legal checks claims about the named competitor.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/objection-handling](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/objection-handling)
